name: @pipeworx/mcp-codewars

tools.name: user
tools.description: Fetch a Codewars user's public profile by username: honor, clan, leaderboard rank, overall language ranks, and skills.

tools.name: user_completed
tools.description: List completed kata (coding challenges) for a Codewars username, paginated; returns kata ID, slug, name, completion time, and languages used.

tools.name: user_authored
tools.description: List kata authored by a Codewars username; returns each kata's ID, slug, name, rank, tags, and languages it supports.

tools.name: kata
tools.description: Fetch a single Codewars kata by ID or slug; returns name, description, rank (kyu), tags, languages, approval status, total completions, and satisfaction rating.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-codewars forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the codewars pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
